level_one.title: Wave of Light
level_one.description: Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.  Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.  Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_four.title: Holy Fire
level_four.description: Deal 13 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

level_seven.title: Hand of Protection
level_seven.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Divine Shield
level_ten.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spell Shield
level_thirteen.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level_sixteen.title: Tyr's Deliverance
level_sixteen.description: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

level_twenty.title: Bulwark of Light
level_twenty.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

level_one.title: Headhunter
level_one.description: Quest: Zul'jin's first Takedown against each enemy Hero permanently increases his damage dealt by 2.5%.  Reward: After getting Takedowns on every enemy Hero, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

level_four.title: Amani Hide
level_four.description: Lower the cooldown of Amani Rage by 10 seconds and gain 15 Armor while regenerating Health from it.

level_seven.title: Arcanite Axes
level_seven.description: Quest: Twin Cleave's damage is permanently increased by 0.75 every time it hits a Hero.

level_ten.title: Guillotine
level_ten.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

level_thirteen.title: Lacerate
level_thirteen.description: Increase the Slow amount of each Twin Cleave axe by 10% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Wrong Place Wrong Time
level_sixteen.description: If an enemy is hit by both Twin Cleave axes at the same time, they take an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage and count as 5 Hero hits for You Want Axe?.

level_twenty.title: Forest Medicine
level_twenty.description: Regeneration is no longer Channeled, and cannot be interrupted.

level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Grounded Totem
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Wellspring
level_thirteen.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

level_sixteen.title: Earthgrasp Totem
level_sixteen.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Farseer's Blessing
level_twenty.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

level_one.title: Low Blow
level_one.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

level_four.title: Biotic Armor
level_four.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Growing Infestation
level_seven.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Flailing Swipe
level_ten.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

level_thirteen.title: It Hungers
level_thirteen.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_sixteen.title: Universal Carrier
level_sixteen.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

level_one.title: Barbed Chains
level_one.description: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
level_four.description: Quest: Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery.  Reward: Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again.  Passive: Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

level_seven.title: Chilling Touch
level_seven.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80%  additional damage, deals Spell damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Shadow Fissure
level_ten.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Chains of Ice
level_thirteen.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, the enemy is also Slowed by 60% for 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Hungering Cold
level_sixteen.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 (+2.5% per level) damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

level_one.title: Demolitions Expert
level_one.description: Quest: For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds.  Reward: Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.

level_four.title: Give Me Twenty
level_four.description: Quest: Regeneration Globes increase Shield Ally absorb amount by 15, up to 300 permanently.  Reward: After collecting 20 Regen Globes, permanently reduce the cooldown of Shield Ally by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Pinpoint Accuracy
level_seven.description: Particle Grenade deals 25 (+4% per level) more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

level_ten.title: Graviton Surge
level_ten.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 (+4% per level) damage a second.

level_thirteen.title: Unstoppable Competitor
level_thirteen.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Gain Train
level_sixteen.description: Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.

level_twenty.title: Grenadier
level_twenty.description: All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.

level_one.title: Anchored Core
level_one.description: Dark Heart Ritual: +50% Radius +25% Duration  Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage.

level_four.title: Dark Barrier
level_four.description: Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

level_seven.title: Toxic Mark
level_seven.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  The damage over time against Marked Heroes is increased to deal damage equal to 1% of the target's maximum Health. Marked enemies have -15 Armor while Marked.

level_ten.title: Void Eruption
level_ten.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.  Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 112 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Dark Heart's Protection
level_thirteen.description: Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.  Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

level_sixteen.title: Fractured Reality
level_sixteen.description: +25% Void Volley Projectile Damage  Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 (+4% per level) damage to enemies. Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flames.  Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds. Damage increases up to 300%. Damage increase from multiple fires stack.

level_twenty.title: Harbinger's Consumption
level_twenty.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

level_one.title: Shifting Meteor
level_one.description: Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it.  Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor.  Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction once per use.

level_four.title: Catching Fire
level_four.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75.  Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

level_seven.title: Molten Power
level_seven.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

level_ten.title: Sulfuras Smash
level_ten.description: Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.  Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.  Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

level_thirteen.title: Cauterize Wounds
level_thirteen.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Meteor Bomb
level_sixteen.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

level_twenty.title: Heroic Difficulty
level_twenty.description: Molten Core's range is increased by 100% at the start of its duration.  In addition, the cooldown of Molten Core is reduced by 110 seconds when used on a destroyed Fort or Keep.

level_one.title: Field Study
level_one.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

level_four.title: Ruby
level_four.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100%  and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 (+4% per level) when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level_seven.title: Kanai's Cube
level_seven.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Stay Awhile and Listen
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

level_thirteen.title: Super Healing Potion
level_thirteen.description: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more.  Passive: Healing Potion heals for 25% more when the target is under 50% health.

level_sixteen.title: Safety in Numbers
level_sixteen.description: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana Regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.

level_twenty.title: Bottomless Flask
level_twenty.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

level_one.title: Free Drinks
level_one.description: When Healing Brew heals a Hero under 50% Health, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_four.title: Surging Winds
level_four.description: If Blinding Wind targets 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is instantly reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

level_seven.title: The Good Stuff
level_seven.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 42 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this heal amount is increased by 100%.

level_ten.title: Jug of 1,000 Cups
level_ten.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Hindering Winds
level_thirteen.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Two For One
level_sixteen.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
level_twenty.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.

level_one.title: Righteous Assault
level_one.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

level_four.title: Heavy Burden
level_four.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.  Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

level_seven.title: Glimmer of Hope
level_seven.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

level_ten.title: Resurrect
level_ten.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

level_thirteen.title: Piercing Lash
level_thirteen.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Reservoir of Hope
level_sixteen.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

level_twenty.title: Shield of Hope
level_twenty.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.

level_twenty.title: Farseer's Blessing
level_twenty.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

level_one.title: Gathering Storm
level_one.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Hammerang. Restore 6 Mana for each Hero hit. Upon dying, Lose 8 stacks.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals 30% more damage.  Reward: After hitting 80 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 50% damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 150 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 70% damage.

level_four.title: Updraft
level_four.description: Increases Barrel Roll's range by 40% and Shield amount by 70%, and its Shield now lasts indefinitely.

level_seven.title: BOOMerang
level_seven.description: Hammerang's explosion deals 100% additional damage, and hitting enemy Heroes reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Hinterland Blast
level_ten.description: After 1 second, deal 475 (+4.75% per level) damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

level_thirteen.title: Flow Rider
level_thirteen.description: While Tailwind is active, Falstad's Basic Abilities recharge 100% faster.

level_sixteen.title: Crippling Hammer
level_sixteen.description: Increase Hammerang's Slow from 25% to 50%, and Hammerang's explosion also Slows.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Peekaboo!
level_seven.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 (+4% per level) Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Safety Dust
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_twenty.title: Speedy Dragon
level_twenty.description: Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.

level_one.title: Static Charge
level_one.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge.  Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

level_four.title: Electric Fence
level_four.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

level_seven.title: Beam Alignment
level_seven.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

level_ten.title: Black Hole
level_ten.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Feedback
level_thirteen.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Lance
level_sixteen.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

level_twenty.title: Force Barrier
level_twenty.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its cast range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level_one.description: Reduces the cooldown of Infested Drop by 3 seconds and Roachlings have 30% more Health.

level_four.description: Quest: Each Basic Attack against a Hero increases Zagara's Attack Damage by 0.2%.

level_seven.description: Quest: Passively increases the radius of Infested Drop by 20%.  Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes with Infested Drop, it spawns an additional Roachling.

level_ten.description: Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 (+4% per level) damage per second.  Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

level_thirteen.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 20 Armor, taking 20% less damage.

level_sixteen.description: When attacking Heroes, Hunter Killers and Roachlings deal additional damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

level_twenty.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

level_four.description: Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

level_seven.title: Toxic Mark
level_seven.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  The damage over time against Marked Heroes is increased to deal damage equal to 1% of the target's maximum Health. Marked enemies have -15 Armor while Marked.

level_ten.title: Void Eruption
level_ten.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.  Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 112 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Dark Heart's Protection
level_thirteen.description: Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.  Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

level_one.title: Devil's Due
level_one.description: Black Soulstone increases the effects of Regen Globes and Healing Fountains by 2.25% per Soul.

level_four.title: Souls to the Flame
level_four.description: Fire Stomp grants 1 Soul every 3 times it damages an enemy Hero, and heals for an additional 1.3% of its damage dealt per Soul.

level_seven.title: Eternal Flames
level_seven.description: Reduce the cooldown of Fire Stomp by 1 second. When Diablo Stuns an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower, reset the cooldown of Fire Stomp and restore 45 Mana.

level_ten.title: Apocalypse
level_ten.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Hellfire
level_thirteen.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fire Stomp grants 3% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.  While at maximum stacks, Diablo deals 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

level_sixteen.title: Domination
level_sixteen.description: Casting Overpower resets the cooldown of Shadow Charge.

level_twenty.title: Hellgate
level_twenty.description: Teleport and place a demonic rune at target location. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and stunning enemies for 1.75 seconds.

level_one.title: Low Blow
level_one.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

level_four.title: One Good Spread...
level_four.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Growing Infestation
level_seven.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Massive Shove
level_ten.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

level_thirteen.title: It Hungers
level_thirteen.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_sixteen.title: Universal Carrier
level_sixteen.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

level_one.title: Moonlit Arrows
level_one.description: Basic Attacks decrease the cooldown of Light of Elune by an additional 0.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Everlasting Light
level_four.description: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

level_seven.title: Huntress' Fury
level_seven.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce to nearby enemy Heroes.  Passive: Increase Hunter's Mark duration by 1 second, and its cast range by 25%.

level_ten.title: Shadowstalk
level_ten.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

level_thirteen.title: Quickening Blessing
level_thirteen.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Light of Elune increases the target's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Attunement
level_sixteen.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

level_twenty.title: Eyes of the Huntress
level_twenty.description: Shadowstalk reveals all enemy Heroes for 10 seconds and heals for 100% more.

level_one.title: Gathering Storm
level_one.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Hammerang. Restore 6 Mana for each Hero hit. Upon dying, Lose 8 stacks.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals 30% more damage.  Reward: After hitting 80 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 50% damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 150 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 70% damage.

level_four.title: Updraft
level_four.description: Increases Barrel Roll's range by 40% and Shield amount by 70%, and its Shield now lasts indefinitely.

level_seven.title: BOOMerang
level_seven.description: Hammerang's explosion deals 100% additional damage, and hitting enemy Heroes reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Mighty Gust
level_ten.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Flow Rider
level_thirteen.description: While Tailwind is active, Falstad's Basic Abilities recharge 100% faster.

level_sixteen.title: Crippling Hammer
level_sixteen.description: Increase Hammerang's Slow from 25% to 50%, and Hammerang's explosion also Slows.

level_one.title: Backlash
level_one.description: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to 12% of their maximum Health.

level_four.title: Jailors
level_four.description: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.  Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors.  Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

level_seven.title: Trag'Oul's Essence
level_seven.description: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.5% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.2% of his maximum Mana.

level_ten.title: Poison Nova
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Echoes of Death
level_thirteen.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

level_sixteen.title: Decrepify
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes that are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Mortal Wound
level_twenty.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Once Again the First Time
level_one.description: Quest: Hit 20 Heroes with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes without dying.  Reward: Increase the maximum number of active Echoes to 2, and increase Echo damage to 50%.

level_four.title: Chronic Conditions
level_four.description: Time Trap will activate on enemy Heroes automatically.  After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds and allies gain 25% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Mobius Loop
level_seven.description: Dragon's Breath deals 30% bonus damage to enemies hit by its center. Enemy Heroes hit by its center are Slowed by 40% for 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Temporal Loop
level_ten.description: Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.  Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.

level_thirteen.title: Time Out
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

level_sixteen.title: Shifting Sands
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Chromie's primary Sand Blast grants 5% Spell Power for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 50%. The duration is refreshed whenever an enemy is damaged by the primary Sand Blast.

level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Grounded Totem
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Wellspring
level_thirteen.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

level_sixteen.title: Earthgrasp Totem
level_sixteen.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Farseer's Blessing
level_twenty.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

level_one.title: Righteous Assault
level_one.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

level_four.title: Heavy Burden
level_four.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.  Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

level_seven.title: Glimmer of Hope
level_seven.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

level_ten.title: Crystal Aegis
level_ten.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

level_thirteen.title: Piercing Lash
level_thirteen.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

level_one.title: Power Hungry
level_one.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

level_four.title: Triumvirate
level_four.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level_seven.title: Zei's Vengeance
level_seven.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

level_ten.title: Disintegrate
level_ten.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

level_thirteen.description: Increase Li-Ming's Spell Power by 20%, but decrease her maximum Health by 15%.

level_sixteen.description: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270 (+3% per level) to 371 (+3% per level).

level_twenty.description: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.

level_four.description: Enemy Heroes within your Defense Matrix receive 35% less healing.  Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Defense Matrix by 0.1875 seconds.

level_seven.description: The initial speed bonus of Boosters is increased to 300%, then decays to normal boost speed over 0.5 seconds. During this time, Boosters Stuns for 0.5 seconds.

level_ten.description: D.Va's Mech becomes Unstoppable and stomps every 0.5 seconds, dealing 78 (+4% per level) damage in a large area. Every 4th consecutive hit on a Hero deals 80% more damage and Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.  Lasts for 4 seconds.  Requires Mech Mode.

level_thirteen.title: Target Locked
level_thirteen.description: Enemy Heroes that remain in your Defense Matrix for 0.75 seconds have their Armor reduced by 15 and their Movement Speed reduced by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Diverting Power
level_sixteen.description: Defense Matrix's area grows drastically in size and each time it reduces damage dealt to Heroes D.Va's Mech is healed for 31 (+4% per level) Health.

level_twenty.title: Stop and Pop
level_twenty.description: Increase Bunny Hop's duration by 4 seconds, and it does not decay while D.Va's Mech is stationary.

level_one.description: When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor, reducing the damage taken by the next Ability by 50%. Gain 1 charge per cast and store up to 4 charges.  Passive: Li-Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, increase the range of All Shall Burn by 25% and Demon Warriors gain 20% Attack Speed and Movement Speed. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

level_four.title: Hellforged Armor
level_four.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 20 Armor and lose 25% less health per second.

level_seven.title: Master of Destruction
level_seven.description: If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration, All Shall Burn's final damage applies to all enemies in an area around the target and grants 1 Annihilation per Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Demonic Invasion
level_ten.description: Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 30 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 20 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

level_thirteen.title: Cydaea's Kiss
level_thirteen.description: Reduces the Channel time of All Shall Burn by 0.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, Azmodan is healed for 8% of his maximum Health.

level_sixteen.title: Hell Rift
level_sixteen.description: If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills the target, a Demon Warrior is summoned at the target's location and all Demon Warriors deal 35% increased damage for 5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Sin's Grasp
level_twenty.description: All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes. While active, the target is Slowed by 15%, and if it lasts its full duration, they are Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds.  If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 50%.

level_one.title: Widowmakers
level_one.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.  Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

level_four.title: Blood Ritual
level_four.description: If an enemy dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, restore 2% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana.  Passive: Takedowns grant 3 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

level_seven.title: Spirit of Arachyr
level_seven.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

level_ten.title: Ravenous Spirit
level_ten.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ice Block
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Spider Colony
level_sixteen.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Vile Infection
level_twenty.description: Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.  Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 66 (+4% per level) to 165 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds.

level_one.title: Gluttony
level_one.description: Increase the number of stacks of Annihilation gained by hitting Heroes with Globe of Annihilation from 2 to 4.  Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, each enemy hit by Globe of Annihilation reduces its cooldown by 0.25 seconds, doubled against Heroes. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

level_four.title: Army of Hell
level_four.description: Summon Demon Warrior spawns an additional Demon, but its cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.

level_seven.title: Art of Chaos
level_seven.description: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 2 Annihilation.

level_ten.title: Tide of Sin
level_ten.description: Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

level_thirteen.title: Cydaea's Kiss
level_thirteen.description: Reduces the Channel time of All Shall Burn by 0.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, Azmodan is healed for 8% of his maximum Health.

level_sixteen.title: Total Annihilation
level_sixteen.description: Globe of Annihilation damages Heroes for an additional 4% of their maximum Health.

level_twenty.title: Sin's Grasp
level_twenty.description: All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes. While active, the target is Slowed by 15%, and if it lasts its full duration, they are Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds.  If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 50%.

level_one.title: Low Blow
level_one.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

level_four.title: One Good Spread...
level_four.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Growing Infestation
level_seven.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Massive Shove
level_ten.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

level_thirteen.title: It Hungers
level_thirteen.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_sixteen.title: Superstrain
level_sixteen.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

level_twenty.title: Top Off
level_twenty.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

level_one.title: Evenhanded Blessings
level_one.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

level_four.title: Piercing Light
level_four.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

level_seven.title: Binding Heal
level_seven.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

level_ten.title: Holy Word: Salvation
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

level_thirteen.title: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
level_thirteen.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Renew
level_sixteen.description: Flash Heal heals an additional 180 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds. The duration of this heal is refreshed each time Anduin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack.

level_twenty.title: Light of Stormwind
level_twenty.description: Holy Word: Salvation grants allied Heroes Invulnerability instead of Protected. This does not affect Anduin.  Channeling Holy Word: Salvation for its full duration reduces its cooldown by 60 seconds.

level_one.title: Laws of Hope
level_one.description: Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds.  Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

level_four.title: Hold Your Ground
level_four.description: Increases Iron Skin's Shield by 40% and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Holy Fury
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Shrinking Vacuum
level_sixteen.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 30% and Slows by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Fury of the Swarm
level_one.description: After casting Ravage, Kerrigan's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds splashes for 100% damage around the target.

level_four.title: Kinetic Fulmination
level_four.description: Damaging an enemy increases the damage of Kerrigan's next Impaling Blades within 10 seconds by 10%, up to 100%.

level_seven.title: Bladed Momentum
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Kerrigan's Basic Abilities by 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Maelstrom
level_ten.description: Deals 74 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Chrysalis
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place Kerrigan in a Chrysalis with 650 (+4% per level) Health for 5 seconds. While inside, Kerrigan regenerates 4% of her maximum Health per second.  Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early.

level_sixteen.title: Painful Spikes
level_sixteen.description: Enemies hit by Impaling Blades take an additional 60 (+4% per level) damage the next 6 times Kerrigan damages them within 5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Omegastorm
level_twenty.description: Maelstrom's duration is increased by 0.4 seconds every time it damages a Hero.

level_one.title: Headhunter
level_one.description: Quest: Zul'jin's first Takedown against each enemy Hero permanently increases his damage dealt by 2.5%.  Reward: After getting Takedowns on every enemy Hero, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

level_four.title: Amani Hide
level_four.description: Lower the cooldown of Amani Rage by 10 seconds and gain 15 Armor while regenerating Health from it.

level_seven.title: Arcanite Axes
level_seven.description: Quest: Twin Cleave's damage is permanently increased by 0.75 every time it hits a Hero.

level_ten.title: Guillotine
level_ten.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

level_thirteen.title: Lacerate
level_thirteen.description: Increase the Slow amount of each Twin Cleave axe by 10% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Wrong Place Wrong Time
level_sixteen.description: If an enemy is hit by both Twin Cleave axes at the same time, they take an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage and count as 5 Hero hits for You Want Axe?.

level_one.title: Anchored Core
level_one.description: Dark Heart Ritual: +50% Radius +25% Duration  Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage.

level_four.title: Dark Barrier
level_four.description: Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

level_seven.title: Toxic Mark
level_seven.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  The damage over time against Marked Heroes is increased to deal damage equal to 1% of the target's maximum Health. Marked enemies have -15 Armor while Marked.

level_ten.title: Void Eruption
level_ten.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.  Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 112 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Dark Heart's Protection
level_thirteen.description: Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.  Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

level_sixteen.title: Fractured Reality
level_sixteen.description: +25% Void Volley Projectile Damage  Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 (+4% per level) damage to enemies. Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flames.  Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds. Damage increases up to 300%. Damage increase from multiple fires stack.

level_twenty.title: Harbinger's Consumption
level_twenty.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

level_one.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

level_four.title: Taste For Explosions
level_four.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Frag Launcher increases its damage by 0.2%, up to 40%.

level_seven.title: Sticky Wicket
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Rocket Ride
level_ten.description: After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving.  After 3.75 seconds, Junkrat lands, dealing 935 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and activating Total Mayhem. 5 seconds after landing, Junkrat reappears at the Hall of Storms and gains 150% additional Movement Speed until dismounted.

level_thirteen.title: Bombs Away
level_thirteen.description: Increase Junkrat's Basic Attack range by 1. Frag Launcher grenades fired within 0.5 seconds of using a Basic Attack deal 30% bonus damage.

level_sixteen.title: Spread Volley
level_sixteen.description: Activate to make Frag Launcher fire 2 additional grenades in a spread. Works for up to 4 total charges, or until Frag Launcher runs out of charges.

level_twenty.title: Cannonball!
level_twenty.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

level_one.title: Fury of the Swarm
level_one.description: After casting Ravage, Kerrigan's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds splashes for 100% damage around the target.

level_four.title: Kinetic Fulmination
level_four.description: Damaging an enemy increases the damage of Kerrigan's next Impaling Blades within 10 seconds by 10%, up to 100%.

level_seven.title: Bladed Momentum
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Kerrigan's Basic Abilities by 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Maelstrom
level_ten.description: Deals 74 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Psionic Barrier
level_thirteen.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

level_sixteen.title: Painful Spikes
level_sixteen.description: Enemies hit by Impaling Blades take an additional 60 (+4% per level) damage the next 6 times Kerrigan damages them within 5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Assimilation Blades
level_twenty.description: Damaging an enemy increases Basic Attack damage by 2% for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

level_one.title: Molten Blood
level_one.description: While Deathwing has 3 or more Armor Plates, he heals for 0.6% of his maximum Health per second.

level_four.title: Infernus
level_four.description: Increase the damage of Molten Flame against enemy Heroes by 25%. Increase this damage bonus to 75% when Molten Flame is cast at 75 Energy or higher.

level_seven.title: Skyfall
level_seven.description: After using Dragonflight, Deathwing can drop meteors anywhere within vision dealing 58 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area. Has 3 charges.  If a Hero is hit, Deathwing heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

level_ten.title: Bellowing Roar
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Deathwing unleashes a mighty roar, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and causing them to run in Fear for 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Wicked Inferno
level_thirteen.description: Molten Flame's Energy cost per second is reduced by 10. After using Molten Flame, Deathwing gains 15 Energy over 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Conflagration
level_sixteen.description: Dealing 320 (+4% per level) damage with Molten Flame to enemy Heroes within 4 seconds causes them to burn for an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. While burning, they explode every 1 second, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

level_twenty.title: Stood in the Fire
level_twenty.description: Enemy Heroes are Slowed by 40% while standing in scorched ground, and its duration is increased by 50%.

level_one.title: Press the Advantage
level_one.description: Increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_four.title: In the Rhythm
level_four.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

level_seven.title: Melting Point
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: That's the Stuff!
level_thirteen.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

level_sixteen.title: Sizzlin' Attacks
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

level_twenty.title: Big Red Button
level_twenty.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.

level_one.title: Barbed Chains
level_one.description: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
level_four.description: Quest: Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery.  Reward: Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again.  Passive: Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

level_seven.title: Chilling Touch
level_seven.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80%  additional damage, deals Spell damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Shadow Fissure
level_ten.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Chains of Ice
level_thirteen.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, the enemy is also Slowed by 60% for 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Hungering Cold
level_sixteen.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 (+2.5% per level) damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

level_twenty.title: Might of the Scourge
level_twenty.description: If a Hero is hit with Shadow Fissure, a second one is cast below them 1 second later. This second cast will not duplicate itself.

level_one.title: Fatal Wounds
level_one.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 70% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health.

level_four.title: Upstage

level_thirteen.title: Pulsing Pain

level_sixteen.title: Lingering Ailment

level_twenty.title: Silent Killer

level_one.title: Simple Geometry

level_four.title: Explosive Arrows

level_seven.title: Never Outmatched

level_ten.title: Dragonstrike
level_ten.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

level_thirteen.title: Mounted Archery
level_thirteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Summon Mount by 2 seconds. Upon mounting, gain 25% additional Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Using Natural Agility instantly mounts.

level_sixteen.title: Piercing Arrows
level_sixteen.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

level_twenty.title: The Dragon Awakens

level_seven.title: Burned Flesh

level_four.description: Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.  Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%. Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

level_thirteen.title: Mortal Strike
level_thirteen.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Banner of Stormwind
level_sixteen.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Glory to the Alliance
level_twenty.description: Banner now also increases health regeneration and all healing received for nearby allied Heroes by 50%, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%.

level_seven.title: Night Terrors
level_seven.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

level_ten.title: Eye of Horus
level_ten.description: Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. level_thirteen.title: Purifying Darts
level_thirteen.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

level_sixteen.title: Sharpshooter
level_sixteen.description: Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.

level_twenty.title: Armored Stance
level_twenty.description: Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.

level_one.title: Extra-Wound Timers
level_one.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

level_four.title: Taste For Explosions
level_four.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Frag Launcher increases its damage by 0.2%, up to 40%.

level_seven.title: Bogged Down
level_seven.description: Enemies launched by Concussion Mine are Slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds upon landing.

level_ten.title: Rocket Ride
level_ten.description: After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving. level_thirteen.title: Ripper Air
level_thirteen.description: Junkrat is knocked back 50% farther by Concussion Mine. Additionally, Concussion Mine's cooldown is reduced by 12 seconds if only Junkrat is hit.

level_sixteen.description: Activate to make Frag Launcher fire 2 additional grenades in a spread. Works for up to 4 total charges, or until Frag Launcher runs out of charges.

level_twenty.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

level_four.title: Surge of Vitality
level_four.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Verdant Flourish
level_seven.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

level_ten.title: Life-Binder
level_ten.description: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.  Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

level_thirteen.title: Dragon Scales
level_thirteen.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Overprotective

level_twenty.title: Ritual of Life
level_twenty.description: Life-Binder activates 3 times over 6 seconds.

level_one.title: Party Mix

level_thirteen.title: All Together

level_sixteen.title: Rejuvenescência

level_seven.title: Chilling Touch
level_seven.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80%  additional damage, deals Spell damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Shadow Fissure
level_ten.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Chains of Ice
level_thirteen.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, the enemy is also Slowed by 60% for 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Hungering Cold
level_sixteen.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 (+2.5% per level) damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

level_twenty.title: Shifting Malice
level_twenty.description: Activate to dash forward, dealing 150 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the path. Takedowns reset the cooldown of Shifting Malice.

level_one.title: Once Again the First Time
level_one.description: Quest: Hit 20 Heroes with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes without dying.  Reward: Increase the maximum number of active Echoes to 2, and increase Echo damage to 50%.

level_thirteen.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

level_sixteen.title: Shifting Sands
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Chromie's primary Sand Blast grants 5% Spell Power for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 50%. The duration is refreshed whenever an enemy is damaged by the primary Sand Blast.

level_twenty.title: Piercing Sands

Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 112 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Dark Heart's Protection
level_thirteen.description: Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.  Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

level_sixteen.title: Fractured Reality
level_sixteen.description: +25% Void Volley Projectile Damage  Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 (+4% per level) damage to enemies. Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flames.  Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds. Damage increases up to 300%. Damage increase from multiple fires stack.

level_twenty.title: Harbinger's Consumption
level_twenty.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

level_one.title: Anchored Core
level_one.description: Dark Heart Ritual: +50% Radius +25% Duration  Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage.

level_four.title: Dark Barrier
level_four.description: Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

level_seven.title: Toxic Mark
level_seven.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  The damage over time against Marked Heroes is increased to deal damage equal to 1% of the target's maximum Health. Marked enemies have -15 Armor while Marked.
